meta.description: Single Source of Truth for reverse-skill task routing. master-route.ps1, verify-routing-coherence.ps1, test-routing.ps1, and extract-summaries.ps1 all read from this file. meta.scoring: Each matching keyword rule increments the candidate score; the highest-scoring route in priority array order wins as PRIMARY; ties are broken by priority order; if no rule matches, fallbackId is selected.
maintainers: The priority table in MASTER-ROUTING corresponds 1-to-1 with the priority array in this file
verify-routing-coherence.ps1 validates consistency between the routing table and documentation
